steps.text: Bring a rope and 1000 gold for Skjaar.
steps.source: Rope. 1,000 gp to buy Key 3142 from Skjaar.

steps.text: Go into Mount Sternum and down the stairs (cyclopes).
steps.source: Enter through the west entrance of Mount Sternum, head downstairs. Be prepared to face some Cyclopes on the first floor.

steps.text: Head west and go down to the skeletons and ghouls.
steps.source: Start by heading west. On floor -2 you will face some Skeletons and a few Ghouls.

steps.text: Up the ladder in the south, down again, up the next ladder and down here.
steps.source: You start at the stars and go up/down at the arrow markings.

steps.text: Use your rope here to go up to Skjaar.
steps.source: You will need to find Skjaar below Mt Sternum.

steps.text: He takes 1000 gold and gives you key 3142 if you answer right.
steps.source: You will need to pay him 1,000 gp and take his quiz. The answers to his questions are "redips", "7", and "black" respectively.
After passing the quiz, go through the Level 35 Gate of Expertise and then use Key 3142 to enter the crypt.
Kill the 4 Ghouls and open the southern chests to get the loot.

steps.text: The noble armor is in the southern chests,
steps.source: Kill the 4 Ghouls and open the southern chests to get the loot.
Kill the 4 Ghouls and open the southern chests to get the loot.
